findings.title: Keep the console message in i18next interpolation syntax
findings.body: This React console resource previously used {{0}}, {{1}}, and {{2}}, but now uses Java MessageFormat placeholders and a choice expression. i18next does not interpret that syntax, so multivalued-size validation errors will display literal placeholders and choice text instead of the attribute name and limits. The same regression is introduced in the admin-ui English resource. Keep these console messages in the frontend's supported format rather than copying the server-side MessageFormat string.

findings.title: Validate HTML inside choice alternatives instead of discarding them
findings.body: For error-invalid-multivalued-size and linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit keys, normalization removes the entire choice expression before HTML validation. A translation such as {2,choice,0#|1#value|1

findings.title: Prevent the common suffix from overlapping the common prefix
findings.body: The prefix and suffix scans run independently, so their matched regions can overlap. For example, a message value of foo<script>foo sanitizes to foo: both scans match three characters, and the subsequent sanitized.substring(3, 0) throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Instead of reporting the illegal HTML, verification aborts with an unchecked exception. Bound the suffix scan by the unmatched lengths remaining after the prefix scan.

findings.title: Restore Lithuanian text for the OTP installation instruction
findings.body: The replacement text, 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', is Italian rather than Lithuanian. This replaces an existing Lithuanian instruction with another language during authenticator setup. The identical mistake is introduced in the Lithuanian login bundle's loginTotpStep1. Translate the new instruction into Lithuanian in both bundles.
